fields.description: Per Decision Log #1: v15 only for this release. Dual v15/v16 compatibility is not implemented and must not be selected until a compatibility-service update adds it.
fields.label: Compatibility Mode

fields.description: Per Decision Log #2: single company/facility scope for v1 (ITAG International Company). Must be created as a standard ERPNext Company before it can be selected here.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Free-text facility identifier per Decision Log #2. No dedicated Facility DocType exists in this app - none of the roadmap's builds (ITAG-0.1.0 through ITAG-1.0.0) introduce one, so this remains a permanent free-text field, not a placeholder for a future model.
fields.label: Default Engineering Facility

fields.description: Set by the Validate Configuration action. Production-blocking flags below cannot be enabled until this reads Ready (roadmap Section 9.4).
fields.label: Configuration Readiness Status

fields.description: Cannot be enabled while Configuration Readiness Status is not Ready. Informational only: Engineering Release (Build ITAG-0.5.0) is fully implemented and its baseline requirement is already unconditionally enforced in code - this checkbox does not currently gate any additional behavior.
fields.label: Engineering Release Enforcement

fields.description: Cannot be enabled while Configuration Readiness Status is not Ready. Informational only: Work Order baseline freeze (Build ITAG-0.5.0) is fully implemented and already unconditionally enforced (a Work Order cannot submit without a resolved Engineering Release) - this checkbox does not currently gate any additional behavior.
fields.label: Work Order Baseline Enforcement

fields.description: Cannot be enabled while Configuration Readiness Status is not Ready. Informational only: Traceability (Build ITAG-0.10.0) is fully implemented and already active - this checkbox does not currently gate any additional behavior.
fields.label: Traceability Enabled

fields.description: Per Decision Log #5: ERP attachment (private Frappe file + checksum) is the only supported mode for v1. No external DMS/CAD-PDM integration exists.
fields.label: Default Drawing Storage Mode

fields.description: Not currently read by any code in this app - ECR/ECO and other engineering-event notifications (e.g. Build ITAG-0.6.0's ECR/ECO transitions) are sent unconditionally today, regardless of this setting. No granular per-event notification configuration exists yet.
fields.label: Notify On Engineering Events

fields.description: Restricted to Frappe's standard queue names. Not currently read by any code in this app - Change Impact Analysis (Build ITAG-0.7.0, fully implemented) always enqueues its background analysis job on the "long" queue directly, regardless of this setting.
fields.label: Background Job Queue

fields.description: Days to retain audit/log records. 0 = retain indefinitely. Per Decision Log #12: no specific regulatory retention period has been identified yet.
fields.label: Audit Retention (Days)

fields.description: Read-only marker of which build tier is active on this instance. Set manually (via a data migration/console update, not through this form) by the development/operations team when a new build's capabilities go live - there is no automatic per-build update mechanism in this app.
fields.label: Feature Activation Status
